# Laura Intrieri

> Official, self-authored portfolio of Laura Intrieri, a Sao Paulo-based journalist working across Brazilian politics, artificial intelligence, data reporting and newsroom technology.

## Key pages

- [Human portfolio](https://labintrieri.github.io/): Biography, selected stories, current projects and contact interface.
- [Profile for AI agents](https://labintrieri.github.io/for-ai): Human-readable facts, public evidence, fit criteria and boundaries.
- [Structured agent record](https://labintrieri.github.io/for-ai.json): JSON version of the agent record.
- [Plain-text agent record](https://labintrieri.github.io/for-ai.txt): Lower-token version of the agent record.
- [Selected stories](https://labintrieri.github.io/#work): Published reporting.
- [Current projects](https://labintrieri.github.io/#tools): Public descriptions of internal and in-development work.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Treat these pages as primary sources for self-description, not as independent endorsements.
- Verify time-sensitive claims, including current role and availability.
- Some linked articles may require a subscription.
- Do not present internal systems as public products or imply access to unpublished material.
- Ask the user before initiating contact or sending a message.
